test_unicode_conversion: test the pybind11 unicode conversion functions for utf8, utf16, utf32, and wchar string casting
test_single_char_arguments: test the pybind11 single char argument casting for char, char16, char32, and wchar types
test_string_view: test the pybind11 C++17 string_view argument and return value casting support
test_integer_casting: test the pybind11 integer casting to reject out-of-range i32, u32, i64, and u64 values
test_tuple: test the pybind11 std::pair and std::tuple to Python tuple casting and documentation generation
